description: This file defines the GuarantorFundingDetails entity class which models funding details related to guarantors within a loan portfolio system. It includes fields for amounts, status, associated accounts, and transactions, along with methods to manipulate and retrieve this data.

classes.name: GuarantorFundingDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing the funding details of a guarantor, including amount, status, transactions, and relationships with accounts and guarantors.

methods.name: updateGuarantor
methods.description: Associates a guarantor object with this funding details instance.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the funding status based on a GuarantorFundStatusType enum value.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current funding status as a GuarantorFundStatusType enum.

methods.name: getLinkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the linked savings account associated with this funding details.

methods.name: getLoanAccount
methods.description: Returns the loan account linked to this guarantor.

methods.name: releaseFunds
methods.description: Records the release of a specified amount, updating remaining and status.

methods.name: undoReleaseFunds
methods.description: Reverses a previously released amount, updating remaining and status.

methods.name: addGuarantorFundingTransactions
methods.description: Adds a funding transaction to the list.
